name: Nemesnádudvar (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nemesnádudvar (a blue shield with a bunch of grapes and a cross) between the names NADWAR above and NEMESNÁDUDVAR below in tan.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
